faq.q: Can I change plans at any time?
faq.a: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes take effect immediately and billing is prorated.
Yes! We accept Orange Money, MTN Mobile Money, Wave, Airtel Money as well as Visa/Mastercard and bank transfers.
At the end of your trial, you choose a paid plan or your account becomes read-only. Your data is retained for 60 days.
No setup fees for Starter and Pro plans. The Enterprise plan may include configuration fees depending on integration needs.

about.title: About RecallVET
about.subtitle: We're building the future of veterinary medicine in Africa
about.mission_text: RecallVET was born from a simple observation: African veterinary professionals deserve digital tools that match their expertise. Our mission is to provide a complete, affordable platform adapted to African realities to digitize and professionalize veterinary practice across the continent.
about.vision_text: To be the reference platform for animal health in Africa by 2030, covering 50 countries and contributing to improved food security and animal welfare.

values.title: Innovation
values.desc: We develop modern solutions adapted to local constraints (connectivity, languages, currencies).

values.title: Reliability
values.desc: Your data is sacred. Bank-level security, automatic backups, guaranteed uptime.
